description: This file defines the 'jsAlerts' class responsible for generating JavaScript alert scripts related to notifications, reminders, and activity alerts within a SuiteCRM environment. It primarily manages alert messages for meetings, calls, and system timeouts, incorporating database interactions and external integration points.

classes.name: jsAlerts
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing JavaScript alert scripts for notifications, including activity reminders and timeout alerts within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the alert script with default messages, activity reminders, and timeout alerts based on configuration.

methods.name: addAlert
methods.description: Adds a new alert message to the script with specified parameters such as type, name, description, and timing.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Returns the complete JavaScript script encapsulated within <script> tags.

methods.name: getRelatedName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a parent entity (like a contact or account) given its type and ID.

methods.name: addActivities
methods.description: Generated alerts for upcoming meetings and calls based on user schedule data, integrating with external meeting systems if configured.
